effect_description_eng:
[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may place 1 Tamer card or 1 level 4 or lower black card among them as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card. Return the rest to the top or bottom of the deck.
[End of Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 Tamer card from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has the [Machine] trait, it gains ＜Collision＞ (During this Digimon's attack, all of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞, and must block if possible.)
